meta.title: Calgary new-construction project timelines
meta.match: address (originaladdress + locationaddresses), issue dates within +-450 days, nearest wins
meta.licence: City of Calgary Open Data, Open Government Licence - Calgary
meta.basis: measured from city records; closing dates are administrative
limitations: Single-unit houses rarely have HVAC/plumbing/gas permits in the open data; summary excludes buildings missing any trade.
Buildings with all four trades may differ from those without.
Span = first trade permit issued to last closed across all matched permits.
Address join is ours, not a city key; one city only; no envelope milestone exists.
